competency.title: Define consolidation — field data
competency.outcome: Specify operational terms and boundaries for consolidation using an episode-to-summary pipeline. Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
competency.practice_task: Produce a glossary with a positive and a negative case grounded in an episode-to-summary pipeline.
competency.setting_constraint: Use a provenance-checked real dataset with consent and access rules.
required_evidence: a glossary with a positive and a negative case
Include the data card, missingness check and permitted use.
Report factual retention and compression ratio with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: compressing away rare exceptions.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of consolidation.
Practice: the definitions separate valid from invalid cases.
Measurement: report factual retention and compression ratio against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for compressing away rare exceptions; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
